Dubai Silicon Oasis successfully concludes the second Middle East edition of DOERS Summit Dubai 2026 at Dubai Digital Park. The summit brings together more than 6,000 participants from 130 countries for 100 interactive sessions and workshops exploring global innovation ecosystems, investment opportunities and ways to build strategic partnerships. During the summit, Dubai Silicon Oasis signs a memorandum of understanding with Germany’s Fraunhofer Institute for Production Systems and Design Technology to support the development of the research, development and innovation ecosystem at the zone and District IO.
